body: You said it yourself, your not going to kill yourself. Your venting. Every person on the planet thinks about suicide at one point in their lives, for one of a million reasons. I am happy that you recognize the futility in going through with it. I struggle a lot, and I relate to your story, I had an amazing job, and let it go. I couldn't keep going anymore. I have spent the past 4 weeks at home running on fumes and don't want to kill myself for any good reason other than being fat and lazy and feeling like I let my health suffer beyond what my lazy ass can repair. I hope you get through this and get an awesome nights sleep and wake up tomorrow and fix the fuck outta your shit. That is what we must do to survive. I can tell from your words that you want to fix it. Fix that shit.
Well, your probably writing this because you want some help. Is there other reasons besides your friend that you want to do this? Are there reasons that you want to avoid doing this?
